providerNotice: Also requests sign-out from other applications at your SSO provider.

reasons.local_session: Central logout requires a new SSO session. Local logout is available.
reasons.provider_unavailable: Central logout is not configured or the provider is unavailable.
reasons.missing_correlation: Sign in again through SSO to enable central logout.
reasons.provider_failed: You are signed out here. Provider logout could not be started.

networkErrorDescription: The connection failed. Your server session may still be active. Reload and try again when connected.
callbackFailed: Provider logout did not complete. You remain signed out of Attraccess.
callbackPartial: The provider reported partial logout. Some other applications may still be signed in.
callbackReturned: You are signed out of Attraccess. Sign-out in other applications depends on your provider.
